name: Bagheli
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Checked Grierson LSI Vol VI (Eastern Hindi, incl. Bagheli) full text on archive.org: no stress/accent passage; Glottolog lists only wordlist-or-less docs.

sources.citation: Language Division, Office of the Registrar General, India. [uploaded 2023]. Linguistic Survey of India – Uttar Pradesh. New Delhi.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bagheli is only named ('close to Awadhi'); no Bagheli chapter. Its bibliography cites Pathak 1980 and H. L. Shukla 1969.

sources.citation: Shukla 'Saras', Srinivas. 2009. बघेली-हिन्दी शब्दकोश. Bhopal: Sanskriti Sanchalanalay.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Dictionary; a full-text search for stress/accent बलाघात/स्वराघात finds nothing.

sources.citation: Singh, Suryabhan (सूर्यभान सिंह). 2007. बघेली व्याकरण [Bagheli grammar]. Bhopal: Madhya Pradesh Hindi Granth Akademi. 96 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Chapter 'बघेली स्वर एवं व्यंजन ध्वनियाँ' (pp. 1-2) lists vowel and consonant sounds only; no बलाघात/स्वराघात/accent anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent scanned + read of the chapter).

sources.citation: Zograph, G. A. 1982. Languages of South Asia: A Guide (partial scan, Hindi chapter).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.citation: Pattanayak, D. P., E. Annamalai & K. P. Acharya. 1978. Classified Bibliography of Articles in Indian Linguistics. Mysore: CIIL.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic record only: 'Pathak, R. S. The Intonation of Bagheli, 38:4, 1977, 197-209'.

sources.citation: Grierson, G. A. 1904. Linguistic Survey of India, Vol. VI: Indo-Aryan Family, Mediate Group: Eastern Hindi. Calcutta.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bagheli grammar sketch and specimens; the only 'accent'/'stress' hits in the whole volume concern Nagpuria. No Bagheli stress passage (confirms the earlier scan).

sources.citation: Kellogg, S. H. 1876. A Grammar of the Hindi Language.. also the colloquial dialects of Marwar, Kumaon, Avadh, Baghelkhand, Bhojpur, etc. Allahabad: Am. Presbyterian Mission Press.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: §27 (pp. 14-15): 'Accent, although unquestionably existing in Hindi, is much less strongly marked than in English, and is quite subordinate in importance to Quantity'; §335: in verbs the accent stays on the root syllable, on the causal affix in derived causatives. Statements are about Hindi in general, not specific to the Baghelkhand dialect.

sources.citation: Tiwari, Udai Narain. हिन्दी भाषा का उद्गम और विकास. Allahabad: Bharti Bhandar. Bagheli section pp. 282-287.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bagheli section compares forms with Awadhi (after Kellogg/Grierson); no stress term in it. The book's स्वराघात chapter is Old/Middle Indo-Aryan history, not Bagheli.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2015. Change Request 2015-012 ([ppa] merged into [bfy]).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Administrative document; cites H. L. Shukla 1986 Tribal heritage of MP; nothing on phonology.

sources.citation: Bahri, Hardev. 2014 repr. हिन्दी: उद्भव, विकास और रूप. Allahabad: Kitab Mahal. §4.2.1 बघेली.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: §4.2.1 lists Bagheli traits vs Awadhi (v > b, postpositions, pronouns, verb endings); nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Tomar, Ram Singh (डॉ० श्रीरामसिंह 'तोमर'). 1962. बघेली भाषा और साहित्य. Patna: Bihar Rashtrabhasha Parishad. 16-page booklet.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Introduction, short grammar sketch (nouns, postpositions, after Kellogg) and literature; nothing on sounds or stress.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 bagh1251 page; Wikipedia 'Bagheli language' (raw wikitext); Shodhganga title searches ('Bagheli', 'बघेली')
sources.note: Glottolog lists no descriptive work; Wikipedia phonology section is unsourced and has no stress statement, its Further Reading gives Pathak 1980, H. L. Shukla 1969, B. P. Shukla 1972, Koshy et al. 2004. Shodhganga shows only folklore/literature theses on Bagheli, no linguistic thesis.
